metaDescription: ETM treatments at Meron Healing Space - Whole Body Reset, Signature Massage, Facial Reset, Breathwork Sessions and Lifestyle & Wellbeing Coaching.
heroText: Every treatment is personalised because every person is unique. If you are unsure which suits you, get in touch and we will find it together.
helpText: Tell us how your body feels and what you would like to feel differently, and we will recommend the treatment that suits you best. There is no obligation to book.
supportIntro: ETM works with the whole body rather than any single part of it. These are the areas people most often come to us for.

items.title: Better Sleep
items.text: Relax the body and calm the nervous system to encourage deeper, more restorative sleep.

items.title: Stress Relief
items.text: Release physical and emotional tension, helping you feel calmer, clearer, and more present.

items.title: Facial Tension Relief
items.text: Stress is often held in the face, jaw, scalp, and neck. Gentle facial treatments help soften tight muscles, encourage relaxation, improve circulation, and leave your skin looking refreshed while promoting a sense of calm throughout the body.

items.title: Nervous System Support
items.text: Encourage deep relaxation, helping the body shift away from the effects of prolonged stress and into a more restful state.

items.title: Hormonal Wellbeing
items.text: Support overall hormonal wellbeing through relaxation, healthy movement, restorative practices, and stress reduction.

items.title: Immune System Support
items.text: By encouraging relaxation and supporting healthy circulation, treatments help create the conditions that allow the body's natural recovery processes to function well.

items.title: Pain and Muscle Tension
items.text: Ease tight muscles, reduce stiffness, and improve comfort in everyday movement.

items.title: Mobility and Flexibility
items.text: Support healthy movement, improve posture, and encourage greater flexibility throughout the body.

items.title: Weight Management Support
items.text: Encourage sustainable lifestyle habits through mindful movement, healthy routines, stress reduction, and body awareness.

items.title: Circulation and Recovery
items.text: Gentle therapeutic techniques help encourage healthy circulation and support the body's natural recovery after physical or mental fatigue.

items.title: Breath and Relaxation
items.text: Guided breathing encourages calm, improves body awareness, and creates space for stillness.

items.title: Whole-Body Wellbeing
items.text: Every treatment is designed to help you reconnect with your body, restore balance, and develop simple habits that support long-term wellbeing.

note: ETM is a complementary wellbeing practice designed to support relaxation and general wellbeing. It is not a substitute for medical care, and does not diagnose or treat medical conditions. Please continue with any treatment prescribed by your doctor.
